name: Hyundai and Kia Airbag Control Unit (ACU) Defect Settlement
summary: $62.1 million settlement resolving claims that certain Hyundai and Kia vehicles have defective airbag control units that may fail to deploy the airbag correctly in a collision.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you own or lease an eligible vehicle (2011-2019 Hyundai Sonata/Sonata Hybrid, 2018-2023 Hyundai Kona, 2022-2023 Hyundai Kona N, 2019-2021 Hyundai Veloster, 2010-2013 Kia Forte/Forte Koup, 2011-2020 Kia Optima, 2011-2016 Kia Optima Hybrid, or 2011-2012/2014 Kia Sedona) as of April 14, 2025?
